description: This file contains WebAssembly integration code for PNG encoding and decoding, including memory management and utility functions, specific to the 'squoosh_png' module within the Next.js project.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes image data into PNG format using WebAssembly.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes PNG data into ImageData using WebAssembly.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes references to wasm and memory to trigger garbage collection.
